entities.summary: Jayson Antonie Granger Amodio is a Uruguayan professional basketball player who plays for Estudiantes of the Primera FEB. Listed at a height of 6'21⁄2" tall without shoes, and 200 lbs. (91 kg) in weight, he plays at both the point guard and shooting guard positions.
